original_evidence.text: | Repetier-Host | No public source for the primary Windows/.NET Repetier-Host (closed-source, distributed only as a compiled binary from repetier.com; not present under github.com/repetier). Public substitute analyzed: github.com/repetier/Repetier-Host-Mac (Cocoa/Obj-C macOS port) | Cocoa/Objective-C (macOS) + bundled `Sparkle.framework` | Y (Repetier-Host-Mac only, via Sparkle) | check: automatic periodic Sparkle check + notify. download/install: automatic — Sparkle downloads the signed update package and installs/relaunches | Y (Sparkle downloads and installs/executes the update package after passing its signature check) | Feed is **HTTP, not HTTPS**: `SUFeedURL = http://www.repetier.com/updates/rhm/rhm-appcast.xml`; the enclosure/download URL is read from that HTTP-fetched appcast XML | Y (appcast enclosure signed; classic Sparkle DSA signature scheme, `SUPublicDSAKeyFile` configured) | signature (DSA — Sparkle framework's classic update-package signature verification) | bundled public key file inside the app bundle: `RepetierHost/RepetierHost/dsa_pub.pem`, referenced via Info.plist key `SUPublicDSAKeyFile` | RepetierHost/RepetierHost/RepetierHost-Info.plist ("SUFeedURL" = "http://www.repetier.com/updates/rhm/rhm-appcast.xml"; "SUPublicDSAKeyFile" = "dsa_pub.pem"); RepetierHost/RepetierHost/dsa_pub.pem (bundled DSA public key present in repo, confirmed via raw fetch); RepetierHost/Sparkle.framework/* (vendored, prebuilt binary framework — not built from source in this repo) |
